parameters.cleanup_role: Intentional 1 micrometre geometry simplification after G1 interpolation, followed by fixed materialization and an exact final transfer check; mass is recomputed.
parameters.binary_grid_role: Explicit sub-nanometre coordinate regularization before native ingestion; maximum component movement is half a grid step. Final exact transfer, containment and separation checks remain required.
parameters.post_rounding_component_rule: Retain the largest positive connected void component per field sign; fill other positive pockets with material and refuse negative cavity shells.
